items.title: Western Natural Gas Prices Buck Mild Weather Outlook
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices strengthened across the Rockies and California Monday despite forecasts for limited heating demand through early November, while softer prices in major producing regions highlighted a divided cash market.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Hit a Speed Bump on the Road to Winter
items.summary: Natural gas futures retreated Monday despite elevated LNG feedgas demand, with weaker-than-normal heating demand expectations and the prospect of recovering production weighing on nearby contracts while deferred prices showed resilience.

items.title: Middle East Tensions Rise, Pushing Global Natural Gas Prices to Four-Year Highs
items.summary: The possibility of the United States and Iran again trading attacks, along with escalating tensions elsewhere in the Middle East that are once again threatening a broader conflict, continued Monday to push global natural gas prices higher.

items.title: Record Power Demand Exposes a Natural Gas Market Divide
items.summary: Natural gas-fired generation surged by as much as 71% year/year as three major US power markets set summer electricity demand records, but ample supply helped temper the impact on regional spot gas prices.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Forfeit Momentum as Weather Forecasts Lean Bearish
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures slipped at midday on Monday as traders weighed LNG demand strength against forecasts for milder fall weather.

items.title: Autumn Demand Lull, Blustery Wind Give NatGas Storage Room to Build
items.summary: NGI is projecting the next US Energy Information Administration (EIA) Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report for the week ended Oct. 16 to show an injection of 82 Bcf, up 15 Bcf week/week.

items.title: Production Hits and LNG Strength Bolster Weekly Natural Gas Prices

items.title: North American LNG Exports Gaining Leg Up as Middle East Outages Drag On
items.summary: After more than seven months of Middle East LNG outages caused by the Iran war, North American export projects are getting a boost from buyers increasingly looking for supply diversity, according to developers.

items.title: Mexico Natural Gas Demand Critical to Permian Oil Production, Esentia CEO Says
items.summary: Mexico’s natural gas demand is propping up Texas oil and gas producers, according to Daniel Bustos, CEO of Esentia Energy Systems.
